notes: Sonnet 5.5 is now the team's workhorse, in place of GPT-6 Sol; Opus 5.5 manages and checks, GPT-6 Astra is the CEO. Your settings, chats and workflows move over by themselves
A limit on Opus alone no longer pauses the Sonnet workers or Sonnet chats; Usage shows which model is at its limit
A chat that reaches a subscription's limit carries on on your next subscription, with the whole conversation
On Windows the team's checks now run in Git's bash, so they can pass
Safer and steadier: a formatted answer can never run code inside Crew, a message or a project is sent once, forms keep what you typed, and a damaged file is set aside while Crew still opens
Updates explain any problem in plain words, wait for work in progress, and the window reconnects by itself
Pushing the pointer into the screen's top-left corner stops the assistant at once, even mid-text; the browser, phone and computer tools also work behind an office proxy
